newsitem.title: USA: Several Hoover Dam units out, power unaffected.
newsitem.headline: Several Hoover Dam units out, power unaffected.

text.p: Several power turbine units at the Hoover Dam in Nevada are out of commission, some for unplanned work, but power generation is not being affected, a spokesman for the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation said Wednesday.
That is because the hydroelectric project is still running way below capacity, said spokesman Tim Ulrich.

The Hoover Dam's power generation capacity is 2,078 megawatts from 17 turbine units, four of which are down for regular maintenance, another for work on its water wheel and a sixth for seal ring repairs.
"This is a good time of year (for the outages), because power demand is not that great in the winter," Ulrich said.
Southwest power demand typically peaks in the summer, when air conditioners are switched on.
Ulrich noted the agency will probably release more water through turbines next week, which will also raise power output, in order to draw the reservoir down from recent high levels.
